newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SAA to start Stockholm-Johannesburg cargo service.
newsitem.headline: SAA to start Stockholm-Johannesburg cargo service.

text.p: South African Airways (SAA) will start a freight service next Sunday from Johannesburg to Stockholm, a spokesman for its cargo sales agent in Sweden said on Monday.
"We are starting a direct service on Sunday, October 13 with an Airbus 300 from Stockholm to Johannesburg," Per Jansson, manager of the airline's Swedish sales agent Maersk Air Cargo, told Reuters.
The aircraft, with a capacity of 36 tonnes, is already part of SAA's cargo fleet, Jansson said.
The aircraft would depart from Stockholm's international Arlanda airport at 1600 local time on Sundays and arrive in Johannesburg at 0700 local time on Mondays, Jansson said.
It would have technical stops in Cairo and Harare, but would not pick up cargo at either of these airports, he said.
Jansson said rates from Sweden to South Africa had fallen 20 to 25 percent in the past 12 to 18 months.
